name: Manual fielding: a 2-second window after the last buzz to swipe
message: After the last buzz you now have 2 seconds to swipe, so catches are easier. The swipe must still go the right way.

ops.find:
private const val STRAIGHT_CONE_DEGREES = 25.0
    private const val SHORTEST_INTERVAL_MS = 150.0
ops.replace:
private const val STRAIGHT_CONE_DEGREES = 25.0
    private const val SHORTEST_INTERVAL_MS = 150.0

    /**
     * After the last buzz the swipe still counts for this long (2 seconds), so there is time to swipe properly. A swipe BEFORE the last buzz still has to be
     * within the fielder's window of it (a better fielder forgives more); a swipe after it is never "too late" inside these 2 seconds. Set 0 for the old, strict timing.
     */
    const val LATE_GRACE_MS = 2000.0

ops.find: 4. "Let the computer take it" (the last button) leaves it to the computer.
ops.replace:
**The 2-second window (patch 121):** after the last buzz the swipe still counts for 2 seconds (`ManualCatch.LATE_GRACE_MS`), so there is time to swipe properly. Only a swipe before the last buzz can be "too early"; inside the 2 seconds nothing is "too late". The way (up, left, right, down) must still be right. Set `LATE_GRACE_MS` to 0 for the strict timing.
4. "Let the computer take it" (the last button) leaves it to the computer.
